Examples: * Green rind may form fur, scales, hair, armor, leaves, or background patterns. * White pith may form the face, teeth, bones, eyes, architectural structures, feathers, or fine details. * Red flesh may form mouths, flames, deep cavities, flowers, glowing-style interiors, wounds without gore, or contrasting internal features. * Seeds may be preserved as pupils, spots, scales, rivets, or decorative details.
